rows.en: Hey, don't screw up.
All right! Put some spirit into it too!
Don't let your guard down.
Now, don't let up.
Let's go all out today!
Will we make it back safely?
Right, let's finish this quickly.
Show some guts, too! Guts!
Let's do our best!
Right, let's do this.
With me here, this is a piece of cake.
I think I can fight with peace of mind this time.
Sortieing with you, huh? We should manage.
A mission like this is nothing for us.
I'm counting on you!
Let's see what you can do.
With you, I feel safe.
I'm glad to sortie with you again!
Counting on your skills.
We can do it! There's nothing we can't do!
Look forward to my support, okay?
Follow me. I'll show you a real fight.
I'll give you my support until you're sick of it.
Rely on me a little, okay?
Feeling pretty good today. Let's go.
Let's show 'em our fiery fight!
We should be fine on this mission.
I'm counting on you a bit. Don't let me down.
Can you keep up with my too-dazzling piloting?
We're absolutely invincible together!
Let's wrap this up and go for a drink.
Teaming up with you fires me up. You feel it too, right?
rows.notes: Heard 'katagitte kuru'; probably 'tagitte kuru' (get fired up).

rows.en: I believe in you. Believe in me, too.
Let's go! We can do it!
I'm trusting you with my back. Just kidding!
I'll guard your back.
We're teamed up. The result's already obvious.
Can't stop us! No one can block our path!
With our teamwork, it'll be a breeze, right?
Ah, you can rely on me, you know.
Alright! I'll risk my life for you!
Let's show off our teamwork!
Let's show 'em our ultimate teamwork.
Combine my passion and yours, and who knows what reaction we'll get!
If we make it back safe, treat me to cake.
If we get back alive, I'll feed you my own cooking.
You shouldn't, really. Treating me to steak when we get back!
I just wanted you to stay out of my way.
I told you not to get in my way.
You can't keep up with me. You found that out when you tried.
Looks like we made it back somehow.
I told you not to get in my way.
Is getting in my way that much fun?
From now on, let me do it alone.
This duo ends with this one. We're done.
I feel nothing from you.
Hmm... no, never mind.
Watch your back on the next mission.
I can't take it anymore. We're done as a duo.
We're lucky just to have made it back alive.
Working with you is a pain, I swear.
I can't team up with a spineless wimp like this. Later.
I might feel easier alone after all.
Spare me the babysitting after this one.
I've never had such a painful mission.
That's done. Let's head back.
Mission over. Let's go home.
Yeah! Mission accomplished! Returning!
Let's head back.
It's over. Heading back.
The mission's not over until we're back.
Phew. Glad I didn't mess up.
Looks like we both made it.
Piece of cake!
Keep this up. Let's do our best next time too.
Well, you're better than a cat lending a paw.
rows.notes: Idiom: better than having a cat's paw to borrow; read as faint praise.

rows.en: Keep it up next time as well, you hear.
Let's work together next time too.
Nice work, Santa.
rows.notes: Pun on otsukare (good work) with 'Santa'; pun cannot carry.

rows.en: That was a fight exciting enough to enjoy.
